title: Human-Comparable Screening Sensitivity
body: Screening in three layers - design, patients, interventions/controls - gave GPT human-level sensitivity.
credit: Annabel V. Dang and Lyra G. Toohey

title: Evaluating the effectiveness of large language models in abstract screening
body: GPT-4 matched human include/exclude calls 84-95% of the time and screened 200 abstracts in 10-20 minutes.

title: Full Agreement Across Multiple LLMs
body: ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude all had to agree before a screening call stood - cutting manual work over 70%.
